title: UCUM Code Annotation Mismatch
guidance: A UCUM code contains a human-readable annotation (e.g., {tbl}) that is ignored when comparing units, and the corresponding Quantity.unit value does not contain that annotation. This is a best-practice notice and does not impact the submission pipeline. Verify the unit and annotation in the EHR if data accuracy review is desired.

rules.regex: UCUM Codes that contain human readable annotations like \{[^}]+\} can be misleading \(e\.g\. they are ignored when comparing units\)\.
